subject.title: fix(ci): bound plugin-npm-release git fetch and npm publish with timeout

question: Should plugin releases deliberately fail after 120 seconds for Git fetches and 300 seconds for npm publishing, rather than continue until the broader job timeout?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but choosing these failure thresholds trades protection from stuck runners against successful completion on slow Git or npm transport and is a release-operation policy decision.

options.title: Confirm the proposed bounds
options.body: Accept the 120-second fetch and 300-second publish limits, then merge after a current-base refresh.

options.title: Choose different operation budgets
options.body: Ask for revised fetch and/or publish limits if normal release traffic needs a longer window before failure.

recommendation.title: Confirm the proposed bounds
recommendation.body: Accept the 120-second fetch and 300-second publish limits, then merge after a current-base refresh.
